notes: Strip f: x 8520-10652 plus margin from x 8220 (Waveland Place at x~8249 included). East of the railroads only Marshall Avenue (60 ft, 96 in. sewer, ends at the railroad ROW line), Garrard Avenue (60 ft, printed GARRARD ... AVENUE, along the right edge), a stub street entering Garrard from the east at y~2753 (printed only 'ST...' cut by the plate edge) and Queen City Avenue along the bottom. Queen City Avenue: printed only 'AVENUE' in this strip; QUEEN CITY printed at x~1000-1350 and the street is continuous along the bottom (addresses 1816 ... 1616, 1564, 1550, 1500 near Beekman); it curves gently (centre 5392 at Beekman, 5348 at Garrard). Beekman Street (BEEKMAN ... STREET / ST.): NW-SE diagonal, curves south near (8850,3500), runs S past Fairmount, curves SSW at Knox and runs straight to Queen City. The heavy black line inside Beekman is a track (it runs near the east side in the diagonal and near the west side further south); centres were taken between frontages; points on Beekman carry ~15 px, at the Cummings merge ~25 px. Cummings Street (CUMMINGS printed at x~8050, y~1500; 'STREET' at 8790,3100): narrow street along the west side of the B&O tracks with addresses facing it (1641, 1617-15, 1611-05, 2547-39, 2531-29, 2525, 2504); its centre taken ~30 px east of the block line; it merges into Beekman at the tip of the wedge block. UNSURE NAMES: (1) the east leg of Vinton Street across Beekman, printed only 'ST.' (taken as Vinton because it is in line); (2) the short street from Beekman to Cummings at y~2067, printed only 'ST.' (recorded as '?'); (3) the Garrard stub '?'; (4) Tremont Street, Liddell Street, Knox Street (west leg), Waverly Avenue and Queen City Avenue are printed only 'STREET'/'AVENUE' near this strip and named from their continuous labelled sections further west. Not streets: railroads (B&O SW R.R. 100 ft, the curving spurs), the Mill Creek, the key box top right, the orange/green/pink/grey boundary bands, the dashed 30 ft line at y~3775 in Garrard's block (private way/easement), the 53 in. sewer line at y~4480, large lettering (J.H. JAMES' SUB., RUTH A. BATES, RESERVE, S U ..., C O ...).
